Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technician- II Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technician- II recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process is through a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview on the scheduled date, which is 10 September 2026. There is no prior online application deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Technician- II post?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification is a Graduate in Science or relevant subjects from a recognized university or institution.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Technician- II position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 30 years.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Technician- II role?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 20,000/- plus 18% HRA, totaling Rs. 23,600/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Technician- II post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Technician- II post.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process will be based on a Walk-In Interview.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the Walk-in Interview for AIIMS Jodhpur Project Technician- II recruitment scheduled?
faq.answer: The Walk-in Interview is scheduled to be held at All India Institute of Medical Sciences Jodhpur, Rajasthan.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the Walk-in Interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should carry all original documents, one set of self-attested photocopies of educational certificates, ID proof, and any other relevant certificates as mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The job type for this position is Contractual.
